beats.title: A Warning at the Cave
beats.narration_summary: It is a warm evening in the Seeonee hills. Father Wolf wakes up in his cave, where Mother Wolf rests with their four cubs. Tabaqui the jackal sneaks in and boasts that Shere Khan the tiger will hunt in these hills. Father Wolf is angry, because the Law of the Jungle says a hunter must give warning first. Then something rustles in the bushes, and Father Wolf springs forward, but stops in mid-air!
clues: Tabaqui makes mischief
Shere Khan changed hunting grounds without warning
Shere Khan is lame (Lungri)
tigers should not hunt Man

choice.prompt: Father Wolf springs at something in the bushes, then stops in mid-air. What does he find?
hints: Father Wolf expected an enemy, but his jump stopped short. Whatever he saw was not dangerous.
It is small and brown, with no fur and no claws. The wolves call it a man's cub.

spoiler_reveals: a baby arrives at the cave

beats.title: The Man's Cub
beats.narration_summary: A little brown baby with no fear stands by the cave, holding on to a branch, and laughs at Father Wolf. Father Wolf carries the baby very gently to the cubs, and Mother Wolf is delighted. Then Shere Khan roars at the cave mouth and demands the baby, but his big shoulders are too wide to squeeze in. Mother Wolf, who is also called Raksha, the Demon, tells him to go away. She keeps the baby and names him Mowgli the Frog.
clues: the baby is a man's cub
Mother Wolf is called Raksha, the Demon
Shere Khan's feet are burned from the campfire
the cave mouth is too narrow for a tiger

choice.prompt: Mother Wolf has named her new son Mowgli. When the cubs can run, where does Father Wolf take him?

cards.text: To the Council Rock, to meet the Pack
Far away to a village of men

hints: The Law of the Jungle says the whole Pack must see every new cub.
The wolves meet at a hilltop covered with stones and boulders.

beats.title: The Council Rock
beats.narration_summary: On the night of the Pack meeting, Akela, the great gray Lone Wolf, lies on his rock while the wolves gather below. Akela calls for someone to speak for the man's cub. Baloo, the sleepy brown bear who teaches the cubs the Law, speaks up for Mowgli. Then Bagheera, the black panther, adds a fat bull he has just killed. The Pack accepts Mowgli, and he becomes a wolf of the Seeonee Pack.
clues: a cub must be spoken for by two besides his parents
Baloo teaches the cubs the Law
Bagheera pays a bull
Mowgli is entered into the Seeonee Pack

choice.prompt: Mowgli now belongs to the wolf Pack. What does the storyteller say happens next?

cards.text: Ten or eleven years go by
Mowgli is sent away at once
Shere Khan wins and takes Mowgli

hints: The Pack accepted Mowgli, so nothing bad happens to him straight away.
Telling all of Mowgli's life with the wolves would fill many books, so the storyteller skips ahead.

beats.title: The Red Flower
beats.narration_summary: Mowgli grows up in the jungle, learning from Father Wolf, Baloo and Bagheera. He must never eat cattle, because a bull bought his place in the Pack. Bagheera shows Mowgli the bald mark on his throat and warns him that Shere Khan is plotting against him. Old Akela has just missed his kill. Mowgli goes to the village, takes a pot of glowing fire, the Red Flower, and carries it back to the jungle, laughing.
clues: Mowgli can never eat cattle because a bull bought him
Bagheera was born among men
the Red Flower is fire
Akela is getting old

choice.prompt: Mowgli carries his fire pot to the Council Rock. Akela is lying down beside his rock. What does that mean?

cards.text: The leadership of the Pack is open

hints: Remember that Akela has just missed his kill.
When the leader lies by his rock, the wolves need someone new to lead them.

beats.title: Farewell to the Pack
beats.narration_summary: Shere Khan tries to claim the Pack, and wolves who follow him demand Mowgli. Mowgli swings the burning branch, and the wolves run howling, afraid of the Red Flower. Only Akela, Bagheera and a few friends stand by Mowgli. Then something hurts inside him, and for the first time in his life Mowgli cries. He says a sad goodbye to his wolf family.
clues: Akela missed his kill and is the Dead Wolf
the wolves fear the Red Flower
Mowgli promises not to betray the Pack
Mowgli cries for the first time

choice.prompt: Mowgli says goodbye to the wolves at dawn. Where does he go?

cards.text: Deeper into the jungle to hide
Down the hill to live with men

hints: Bagheera told him that the jungle is closed to him now, because he cries like a man.
He walks away alone, toward the villages of people.

ending.summary: Mowgli goes down the hill alone to meet men; the quest wraps up with a badge summary.
